questions.questionText: What does it mean to set off for a journey?
questions.expectedAnswer: To set off for a journey means to start traveling or begin a trip to a certain destination.

questions.questionText: Would you rather have a boring job with high pay or an exciting job with low pay?
questions.expectedAnswer: I would rather have an exciting job with low pay because job satisfaction is more important than wealth alone.
